name: Verify fallback message when AI Assistant is unavailable
objective: Validate that when the Agentforce AI Assistant service is unavailable, the user receives a clear unavailability message and is provided an alternative method for raising a ticket.
precondition: User is logged in and on the home page. AI Assistant service is intentionally unavailable or simulated as down.

steps.description: Ensure the AI Assistant service is unavailable (simulated or actual outage)
steps.expectedResult: AI Assistant service is confirmed unavailable

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
steps.expectedResult: System attempts to load the AI Assistant

steps.description: Verify a clear unavailability message is displayed
steps.expectedResult: User sees a clear message indicating the AI Assistant is currently unavailable

steps.description: Verify an alternative method for raising a ticket is provided
steps.expectedResult: User is given a link or instructions for an alternative way to raise a ticket (e.g., form link, email)
